title: Approximate Ulam distance

problem.name: Approximate Ulam distance
problem.statement_latex: For two permutations $A,B$ of $[n]$, approximate $u=n-\operatorname{LCS}(A,B)$ within factor $1+\varepsilon$. Complexity uses indexed access; $\varepsilon>0$ is fixed in the displayed bounds.
problem.statement_text: For two permutations $A,B$ of $[n]$, approximate $u=n-\operatorname{LCS}(A,B)$ within factor $1+\varepsilon$. Complexity uses indexed access; $\varepsilon>0$ is fixed in the displayed bounds.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(\sqrt n)$ time by Le Gall--Seddighin's quantum Ulam-distance approximation.
